Hello! How can I help you?\n...What? A magic stone?\n...Ah, yes! I saw it!
The other day, I went to the temple town to the\nsouth of this city but the buildings were ruined.\nOf course, I couldn't find any customers there...

This city was named after the Goddess of Wisdom\nand it used to be the capital city of a country\nhundreds of years ago.
The country and half of the city were destroyed\nby the Cataclysm but...
Pino, the chief consul, and the current Goddess\nof Wisdom took the leadership and restored the\ncity. Now it's the biggest city around here.
Shopping? You didn't see the crow scarer?\nIt says [Visit Sololo's general store!], right?
It's down the alley.\nThe shopkeeper, Sololo is a nice guy and\nhe sells various things.
Strengthen equipment? Then, go straight and\nturn right. You'll find a blacksmith's shop.\nA young man Zaldo is the owner.
At a glance, he looks kinda timid but he's got a\ngood reputation for his smithing skills. You know,\nhis ancestors were blacksmiths.
Hmm, skills... There's a library in the city but\nit's been closed since the scholar who was\nmanaging the library passed away...
Oh, wait...Yes! A Cule woman recently sought refuge\nhere and said she's gonna take care of\nthe library and reopen it in a few days.
She also said she'd put some rare skill books she\nbrought. She'll make you read them and\nmake good money out of it. She's shrewd...
That building? That's the government office.\nPino, the chief consul and the Goddess of\nWisdom is there.
Go inside? No, you can't. Of course, for security\nreasons. Pino herself always says it should be\nopened to everyone though.
But I'm a sentry, so I have to control entry\nfor Pino's safety. I myself want to do as\nPino says though...
Hey, what's wrong? ...Holy Gems?\nI don't know much about them.
They're kinda necessary for us to defeat monsters\nbut we don't really need to know about them except\nhow to use them, right?
Yo, the Savior! ...Huh? Oh, don't play dumb.\nMost people know your heroic deed. You're\nquite strong to have beat that notorious dragon!
I guess I can trust your skills... Actually, we\nsentries train ourselves every day to protect\nthe town but the novices seem half-hearted.
If skilled soldiers like you join the training,\nthey'll be wound up and get serious about it.\nOf course, we'll offer rewards.
Well, there is no rush.\nTalk to me when you feel up to it.\nWe welcome you anytime.

Get some snacks in the plains.\nYou can expect the reward. C'mon!
Alright.
I'm busy now...
That's the spirit. Thanks.\nI need 3 types of snacks. First, Animal Skin...
Huh? It's not food? Oh, c'mon!\nDry it, roast it, and try it.\nIt really goes well with liquor.
And next, Tough Meat.\nSoft meat makes me full cuz I eat too much.\nSo, Tough Meat is much better for drinking.
The last one is Pomum Leaf.\nThat prevents hangover. You got it?\nThanks.
You can find 'em all in the plains, so\nit should be easy.\nBut, watch your step.
You're so mean! ...Well, yea.\nI know nobody willingly collects snacks for\nsomeone else.
If you change your mind, come here again.
Hey! You're back. Let me check them...\nWoow, you've got all of them!\nThanks! Here's the reward for you.
Heeey... Uh... Who're you again?\nWell, it's nice timing. Can you do me a favor?
You know what?\nThe bar-keeper said he found tasty looking nuts\nthough he hasn't tried 'em.
He said they were on a big tree or something like\nflower monster in the Land Under Development.
So, can you go get 'em?\n...Reward? Sure, I'll give you something.
OK.
No.
That's great. Thanks.\nAs I said, they're on huge flower monsters\nin the Land Under Development.
Keep your guard up, or you'll get hurt.\nI'm counting on you!
You're so mean! ...Well, yea.\nI know nobody willingly collects snacks for\nsomeone else.
If you change your mind, come here again.

Heeey... Uh... Who're you again?\nWell, it's nice timing. Can you do me a favor?

OK.
No.

I'm counting on you.\nStay alert, or you'll get injured.
You're so mean! ...Well, yea.\nI know nobody willingly collects snacks for\nsomeone else.

Well, anyway, thanks!\nThis is for you. Take it!
Heeey... Uh... Who're you again?\nWell, it's nice timing. Can you do me a favor?
You know, I was drinking all night, so I've got\na hangover. I feel queasy and my head's pounding.
The synthesist grandma told me Blue Jelly works\nfor headache, and Purple Jelly for stomachache.\nBut I couldn't get them at the store.
So, can you get them for me? You'll be rewarded.\n...By then my hangover will be gone?
No way! Listen!\nMy hangover lasts forever!! You got that?!\nAggh... it really hurts. Hey, please!
Alright.
No, I can't.
That's the spirit. Thanks.\nHere's the note for you.\nBlue Jelly and Purple Jelly, alright?
You're so mean! ...Well, yea.\nI know nobody willingly collects medicine\nfor a boozer.
Come back if you feel sorry for this drunkard.\nSooner, the better.
Hey! You're back. Let me check them...\nWoow, you've got all of them!\nLet's say good bye to hangover!
Thank you. Here's the reward!
Alright, first, I'm gonna clear up my stomach\nwith this purple stuff.
Eww... What the... *gulp*\nHm? Nothing happ...\nSomething's movin' up from my stomach...
W-What the hell is it?!\n...Oh? I'm not feeling sick now.
So... the purple one wraps up the bad stuff in\nmy stomach and makes me spit it up.\n...Sounds gross.
Then, the blue one is...\nI'm not gonna spit up my brain, am I?\n...What? Why not? I'll take it.
...Hm? Nothing happens.\nMy head's still pounding... This is...
Zzz... Zzz... Zzz...
Looks like the blue one made him sleep to ease\nthe headache.
Uhggg... Oh? You're? Well, whoever you are.\nYou came just at the right moment... Ugg...
I don't know if it's because I'm a big drinker.\nBut I have terrible stomachache every half a year.
So, I need some ingredients for... Ugg...\nthis powdered medicine.\nI'll give you something, so please!
I'll get them right away!
I... I'm kinda busy now.
Thanks, I need 1 Animal Horn now.\nYes, 1 is enough. Please! Ugg...
B-But be careful! You need to defeat huge,\npowerful monster to get it! It's no joke if you\nget hurt because of that! Ugghh!
What...? Ouch! ...Well, I know...\nNobody wants to go get medicine for a boozer...\nUgg...
If you feel sorry for a drunkard suffering from a\nstomachache, come back here.\nSooner the better. Ugg...
Oh... You're back. I'm alright. Not dead yet.\nYou got the Animal Horn?
Great! Let's say good bye to the pain!\nYou really saved me. Here's the reward...
Alright, let's get to it.\nGrind the horn and swallow the powder...\n*gulp* Ugg... I thought I was gonna die!
Animal Horns really work!\nNow I can drink again... What?\nWhy don't I refrain from drinking?
The devil made me do it.\nIt's like an incurable disease.\nWell, anyway the stomachache is gone. Thanks.

Alright.

Okay!
No!
